interventions.description: Implementing a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb would provide a safety buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near potential crossing points to ensure pedestrians and drivers can see each other.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to physically reduce vehicle speeds to levels appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage to provide a designated safe point for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer place for residents to cross the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the width of the sidewalk to meet modern accessibility standards and provide a more comfortable walking environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the parking lane to provide physical separation and shade.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions / Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the nearest intersections to improve visibility and reduce crossing distances, preventing large vehicles from parking too close to crossing points.
